Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds p9 (printed p21), Enterprise Funds columns Electric Fund / Water Fund / Sewer Fund (Internal Service Fund and Total not used). JSON receipts = total operating revenues + interest income + grant revenue + loss on asset disposal (printed among nonoperating). Electric: 27,568,371 + 112,923 + 96,213 + 133,901 + 34,982 (= 27,946,390 printed) + interest 23,961 + grant 1,732 = 27,972,083. Water: 4,475,641 + 270,105 + 14,159 + 16,039 (= 4,775,944 printed) + interest 14,517 = 4,790,461. Sewer: 3,445,751 + 78,400 + 7,418 + 1,317 (= 3,532,886 printed) + interest 12,774 + loss (68,416) = 3,477,244. Sum 27,972,083 + 4,790,461 + 3,477,244 = 36,239,788 = statement total. 0 + 36,239,788 = 36,239,788.
